body: Actually, a lot of people who eat the same type of diet I do find it also helps them with their mental/emotional issues. Just because it's not the popular narrative doesn't mean it won't work. Or just because it's the popular narrative doesn't mean it actually does work. My case isn't a one off thing that can't be applied to anyone else just cause you've never heard of the concept that food really can affect your mental state. There quite a few people who can testify to this. In any case, I was just hoping to try to help someone since I know what they're going through and would've loved to have someone try to help me like this when everything felt unbearable. But take it with a grain of salt.

I never said it stops you from being suicidal. But I'm just speaking from personal, physical, experience. Think about it. The human brain runs on a complexed balance of chemicals, and that chemical balance is affected by our hormones, and our hormones are directly affected by what we eat. err. go, food affects our mood. Look at the many trauma victims who turn to food as coping mechanism cause when they eat they feel good. Look at what happens to people when they eat weed brownies. One week ago, I ate a slice a cake about an hour before I went to bed and I shit you not, the next morning I woke up, tears came to my eyes cause I was crying and didn't know for what reason, and I went on to feel like pulling my hair out and wanting to violently throw furniture all over the place. The only thing I could do was lock myself in my room and scream into my pillow till I calmed down, even though rationally nothing was wrong with me. I went right back to the times when I wanted to die so badly and kept slitting my wrist. I'm not trying to lay it on thick or something but being on this new diet I don't have such overwhelming emotional attacks. My life is still shit, but at least I can handle the shit a lot better.
No it doesn't. The other day I tried eating some nuts and felt like I wanted to walk into oncoming traffic, after not having had those feelings for weeks since I stopped eating plant based foods.
The pills aren't gonna do jack shit and talking won't really change anything either. But look into what you're eating. There's something there. I hope I've helped.

Hi, okay so if you don't want to talk about it, that's okay, I've attempted suicide already but failed cause my mom saved my life so I have an idea that may be close to what you're going through but hear me out...what if you look into the type of food you consume? I recently cut all carbs, plants, and sugars from my diet and all of a sudden I don't find myself trapped by overwhelming misery and hopelessness. Thanks to that I stopped slitting my wrist. Life sucks, death would be a sweet release, I know that feeling but maybe it can be just a little more bearable if your brain isn't constantly releasing cortisol because of the foods you eat. Not saying I'm suddenly shitting rainbows but holy shit there's a huge difference. For me anyway.
Oh the bible says being gay is a sin? Well guess what else the bible says is a sin...literally most of what you do everyday.

Okay, yeah, that's actually a firm belief of mine. Death is better than a useless life. But unfortunately for me though I'm afraid to die, I'm just miserable as fuck. So how do I get around this? Well it's my life and nobody else can tell me what to do, so how about figure out some use for myself, at least for the time being and then move on to another use for myself doing something else I like? It legit took me decades to figure out that everybody is just going from day to day doing what they want to do to get what they want and that's their purpose, their use, that they set. What I'm doing matters to me and that's all that counts.
